premise: P1 of issue #48: a question a T3 top-level thread asks through its question tool shows in t3_pending_request list, for a Codex-provider and a Claude-provider thread.
method: The orchestrator launched two scratch top-level threads with t3_thread_launch, runtimeMode auto, each told to ask one question with options A and B and wait. While both runs were still running, it called t3_pending_request list and then read for each thread, then stopped both with t3_thread_interrupt stop. No question was answered. Thread and request ids are left out.
verdict: pass: the chain may launch both providers' threads. Permission approvals are not listed (the tool says so), so a chain thread must run hands-off.
